text.tspan: I signed up for a recurring shift instead of a
one-time splash.
Childcare made it possible for two parents to
volunteer longer.
Quiet week, useful lesson.
Listen before you redesign someone else's
system.
We labeled boxes carefully so the next shift
would not redo our work.
Dignity matters as much as efficiency.
The organizers needed hands more than they
needed advice.
Invite one person with you. Networks grow that
way.

once.

Listen before you redesign someone else's

We stayed for cleanup, which is where half the
work lives. Thank the people who coordinate.
Coordination is labor. Invite one person with
you. Networks grow that way. Community care is
maintenance work.
